brief:
More than 2.7 million ballots have been counted in Israel's elections, with Benjamin Netanyahu's bloc maintaining the lead, Middle East Eye reported. Palestinian-led parties have moved into third place, surpassing Naftali Bennett's Together alliance in the ongoing vote tally announced by Israel's Central Elections Committee.

The shift in standings reflects changing dynamics among the competing political blocs as counting continues across the country.
dek: More than 2.7 million votes counted, Palestinian-led parties overtake Bennett’s Together alliance at third place Israel’s Central Elections Committee announced that over 2.7 million ballots have been counted, with Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc still in the lead.
title: Palestinian-led parties overtake Bennett alliance in Israeli election count
